talking_head_ugc.label: Talking head / UGC
talking_head_ugc.needs: A face and voice that read as a real person, a spoken line that earns the next second, eye contact or motion before 1.5s. Polish optional; a stiff read is the failure mode.

screen_record.label: Screen record / notes app
screen_record.needs: The text IS the hook. Legibility at feed size, typing or scrolling movement, and it must look like a real screenshot, not a designed graphic.

broll_vo.label: B-roll + VO
broll_vo.needs: First shot intrinsically watchable (food, hands, motion, texture); the VO line must attach a question or claim to it inside 3s.

text_card.label: Text card open
text_card.needs: One idea, readable in under 1 second, movement before 1.5s (card swap, zoom, reveal). Two ideas on one card is the failure mode.

founder_location.label: Founder / on-location
founder_location.needs: Unpolished is correct. Place and person legible fast, a reason this person is credible inside the first line. Over-produced founder footage reads as an ad.

podcast_interview.label: Podcast / interview clip
podcast_interview.needs: Mid-conversation energy, a clipped-in-progress line that implies a payoff, captions carrying the load with sound off.
